## Which Apps each Edition can carry

An App ships in an Edition when that Edition builds every Add-on the App needs.

| Edition | Revenue Assurance | Case Management | Fraud Management | Link Analysis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Standard](../../edition/standard/index.md) | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| [Advanced](../../edition/advanced/index.md) | yes | yes | yes | yes |

The Apps' Space Templates are composed into one Space Template, `telco`, over one ingest of the Industry's records.
